description: This Java class implements a service for sending emails via Gmail's SMTP, including methods for sending personalized welcome emails and generic emails using JavaMailSender. It relies on external SMTP configuration data and constructs email messages accordingly.

classes.name: GmailBackedPlatformEmailService
classes.description: A Spring service class providing email sending functionalities using Gmail SMTP, implementing the PlatformEmailService interface.

methods.name: sendToUserAccount
methods.description: Constructs and sends a personalized welcome email to a user with their account details.

methods.name: sendDefinedEmail
methods.description: Sends an email based on provided EmailDetail object, configuring SMTP properties dynamically.
